snippet.title: Supercar Collection Simulator | Xbox Official Trailer - Coming October 16 #xbox #supercarcollection
snippet.description:
You’ve been asking if Supercar Collection Simulator is coming to Xbox. The wait is over!

Build your diecast store, open surprise car boxes, grow your collection, and race. **Supercar Collection Simulator is now available on Xbox.**

Check it out here:  
https://www.xbox.com/En-Us/games/store/p/9nps0qk8lhj6

We launch on October 16!

@XBOX 

More exciting news is coming soon. Stay tuned
